title: One Leak Away: How Pretrained Model Exposure Amplifies Jailbreak Risks in Finetuned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2512.14751v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Finetuning pretrained large language models (LLMs) has become the standard paradigm for developing downstream applications. However, its security implications remain unclear, particularly regarding whether finetuned LLMs inherit jailbreak vulnerabilities from their pretrained sources. We investigate this question in a realistic pretrain-to-finetune threat model, where an attacker has full access to a released pretrained LLM but no access to its proprietary finetuned derivatives. Empirical analysis shows that adversarial prompts optimized on the pretrained model transfer most effectively to its finetuned variants, revealing inherited vulnerabilities from pretrained to finetuned LLMs. To further examine this inheritance, we conduct representation-level probing, which shows that transferable prompts are linearly separable within the pretrained hidden states, suggesting that transferability-relevant structure is already encoded in

translated_title: 一次泄露足矣：预训练模型的公开暴露如何放大微调大语言模型的越狱风险
translated_abstract: 微调预训练大语言模型（LLM）已成为开发下游应用的标准范式。然而，其安全影响仍不明确，尤其是微调后的LLM是否会从其预训练源模型继承越狱漏洞。我们在一个现实的“预训练到微调”威胁模型中研究这一问题：攻击者可以完全访问已公开发布的预训练LLM，但无法访问其专有的微调衍生模型。实证分析表明，在预训练模型上优化得到的对抗性提示能够最有效地迁移到其微调变体上，揭示了从预训练LLM到微调LLM的漏洞继承现象。为进一步探究这种继承性，我们进行了表示层面的探测分析，结果表明可迁移的提示在预训练隐藏状态中是线性可分的，这表明与可迁移性相关的结构已经编码在（预训练模型的表示中）……
tldr: 研究发现，攻击者利用公开的预训练模型优化得到的越狱提示可直接有效迁移到基于该模型的私有微调版本上，证明微调LLM会继承预训练模型的越狱漏洞，公开预训练权重即构成安全隐患。
en_tdlr: Adversarial jailbreak prompts optimized on publicly released pretrained models transfer effectively to their proprietary finetuned derivatives, revealing that finetuned LLMs inherit jailbreak vulnerabilities from their pretrained sources, so the public exposure of pretrained weights alone amplifies downstream security risks.
